requirements.title: Professional Resume Content
requirements.definition: Develop accurate, professionally written resume content representing the client's work history, education, skills, and accomplishments.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the resume's substantive professional and factual content; target-role positioning and Standard or Signature presentation are independently modifiable behaviors.

requirements.title: Standard Resume Edition
requirements.definition: Provide a clean, readable, ATS-compatible resume edition suitable for online applications and available in editable Word and PDF formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the Standard resume's formatting, compatibility, and delivery formats; substantive resume content and the Signature design remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Signature Resume Edition
requirements.definition: Provide a custom Canva-designed and personally branded resume edition for direct outreach, networking, and other presentation-focused use.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently deliverable Signature resume presentation while preserving the substantive content shared with the Standard resume.

requirements.title: Tailored Cover Letter Content
requirements.definition: Develop a tailored cover-letter narrative written in the client's voice and grounded in the client's professional background.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the cover letter's substantive narrative; target-role positioning and each presentation edition can be revised or evaluated independently.

requirements.title: Standard Cover Letter Edition
requirements.definition: Provide a clean Standard cover-letter edition suitable for conventional and online job applications.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the Standard cover letter as a separately deliverable document rather than merging it with the Standard resume or Signature presentation.

requirements.title: Signature Cover Letter Edition
requirements.definition: Provide a Signature cover-letter edition whose visual design follows the branding and presentation established for the Signature resume.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently deliverable Signature cover-letter design; its narrative content and the Signature resume are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Remote-Role Positioning
requirements.definition: Position the resume and cover letter for remote work opportunities while supporting consideration of role types beyond the client's prior assistant-focused work.
requirements.boundary_note: This cross-document targeting strategy can change independently of factual resume details, cover-letter voice, or document presentation.

requirements.title: Included Document Revisions
requirements.definition: Provide up to four rounds of client-directed revisions to the resume and cover-letter materials.
requirements.boundary_note: The revision entitlement is an independently specified package obligation; price and turnaround time are project-management terms and are excluded.
